verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ships a first-party, built-in MCP server that lets AI assistants browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, resolve issues, and run analyses such as N+1 detection. That lets users drive the product in natural language, but only through an external AI client: no native natural-language command interface inside GlitchTip is documented. Missing for 10: a built-in natural-language/chat interface within the product, documentation of the full range of actions operable via natural language (only error investigation/resolution and analysis tools are shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
